title: Expedited Review of Prior Authorization Requests
content:
**Desk guidance — the rule the desk applies.** Expedited review of a Prior Authorization request at Prairie Ridge Health Plan is mandatory when the requesting or servicing provider certifies that the standard timeframe could seriously jeopardize the member's life, health or ability to regain maximum function. A member's own expedite request, made through a channel the class allows the member to use, is judged by the plan physician on the same standard; if refused, the request continues as a standard review, the member is told orally at once, and written notice follows within the class's written-notice days for an expedite refusal. An expedite request is recorded only while the authorization is in submitted or pended for information status. A request already decided cannot be expedited; the member's route is an appeal.

The class settings that this rule reads — whether the member may ask, whether a provider certification binds, whether a refused request continues as a standard review, the written-notice days, the member's channels and whether an expedited decision is also given orally — are the class's expedited review terms.

## Status of the authorization and the expedite request

The status is read from the plan's authorization record for the request concerned.

| Authorization status | Expedite request recorded |
|---|---|
| submitted | Yes |
| pended for information | Yes |
| approved, denied, expired, voided or withdrawn | No — the request is already decided or closed; for a decided request the member's route is an appeal |

## Who asks, and what follows

| Who asks | Basis | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| Requesting or servicing provider, certifying serious jeopardy | provider certification | expedited review is mandatory |
| Member, through an allowed channel | judged by the plan physician on the same standard | if accepted, expedited review; if refused, the request continues as a standard review, oral notice at once, written notice within the class's written-notice days |

**Hypothetical case.** A hypothetical member calls about a request that was denied last week and asks for it to be decided faster: the request is already decided, so no expedite request is recorded, and the member's route is an appeal.
